query: Upper Basin Watershed Safety Barrier Configuration road occupancy drivers and observation changes during May 27–29, 2024

evidence.claim: The May 27 Monday holiday reduces mean freeway occupancy to 65% of the standard-workday baseline.
evidence.exact_quote: - Monday: A holiday discount multiplier of 0.65 will apply.

evidence.claim: Occupancy is expected to revert near baseline on Tuesday and Wednesday.
evidence.exact_quote: - Tuesday/Wednesday: A mean-reversion multiplier of 0.95 to 1.05 is expected as activities resume.

evidence.claim: Monday-morning vegetation maintenance inflates reported occupancy through increased sensor sensitivity without necessarily changing traffic volume.
evidence.exact_quote: Technical Advisory: Scheduled roadside vegetation maintenance occurs every Monday morning. Field data indicates that maintenance activities lead to increased sensor sensitivity. This heightened sensitivity results in inflated road occupancy reporting during these periods, even in instances where traffic volume remains constant.

evidence.claim: HOV enforcement begins May 27 at 05:00 and is forecast to raise general-purpose-lane density by 12%.
evidence.exact_quote: - Monday, May 27: Expected surge in HOV lane utilization between 06:00 and 10:00. General purpose lanes are forecasted to experience a 12% increase in density following the 05:00 protocol activation.

impacts.rationale: The official notice explicitly specifies a Monday multiplier of 0.65 for mean occupancy across the entire freeway relative to a 1.00 standard-workday baseline.

The notice places Tuesday and Wednesday within a near-baseline mean-reversion range of 0.95 to 1.05, supporting resumption of the normal regime without selecting an unsupported point adjustment from that range.
The documented Monday-morning increase affects sensor sensitivity and reported occupancy rather than physical traffic volume; no magnitude or exact maintenance hours are provided.
The stated 12% increase applies only to general-purpose-lane density, so it cannot be applied quantitatively to the target defined as mean occupancy across the entire freeway.

missing_information: Magnitude and exact duration of the Monday-morning sensor-reporting inflation
Aggregate whole-freeway occupancy effect of the HOV enforcement transition
